title: answering
description: Result schema for the answering action. The action posits a triple (subject, predicate, object) and a value into $\Phi$, producing a cell-record at stratum asserted plus the persistence-path the record was appended to (if persistence is requested).

appended-to.description: Filesystem path of the JSONL file the cell-record was appended to. Present only when persistence was requested.

append-index.description: Zero-based index of the appended record in the persistence file.
